conf.description: Cisco NX-OS acl-logging / api-pull: reparse pipeline behind the REST Collector against /ins. The Collector lifts each TABLE_logfile/TABLE_nvram ROW_*.log line to event.original (out of this pipeline's scope -- Collector config, not a pipeline object); this pipeline runs the identical two-dialect ACLLOG body dissect as the snmp-trap format, since NX-API adds no structure to the line.

conf.comment: cisco-nxos / acl-logging / api-pull. event.original arrives already populated by the REST Collector's TABLE_*/ROW_* walk (Collector config is out of pipeline scope). This pipeline recovers the %FACILITY-SEV-MNEMONIC: header for event.code, the leading 'NNNN: ' sequence number when 'logging message sequence-number' is set, and dissects the same two ACLLOG dialects as the snmp-trap format. observer.name/switch_name is NOT extracted here -- the work order gives no sample of the header's timestamp grammar to key off, and itself allows setting observer.name from the poll target at the Collector instead; documented as a gap.

functions.description: document scope: header/sequence recovery plus the shared two-dialect ACLLOG dissect
recover the standard Cisco %FACILITY-SEV-MNEMONIC: header for event.code
dissect the Nexus 5000/6000 long-form ACLLOG dialect

conf.regex: /Src IP:\s*(?<src_ip>[^,]+),\s*Dst IP:\s*(?<dst_ip>[^,]+),\s*Src Port:\s*(?<src_port>[^,]+),\s*Dst Port:\s*(?<dst_port>[^,]+),\s*Src Intf:\s*(?<src_intf>[^,]+),\s*Protocol:\s*"(?<proto_name>[A-Za-z0-9]+)"\((?<proto_num>\d+)\),\s*ACL Name:\s*(?<acl_name>[^,]+),\s*ACE Action:\s*(?<ace_action>[^,]+),\s*Appl Intf:\s*(?<appl_intf>[^,]+),\s*Hit-count:\s*(?<hit_count>\d+)/

functions.description: dissect the Nexus 7000/9000 abbreviated/detailed ACLLOG dialect
recover the embedded per-device sequence number when configured
map the recovered mnemonic to event.code and the sequence number to event.sequence, apply the same body-dissect mapping as the snmp-trap format, and drop temp fields
tag the event with its dataset
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
